links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT-4o answers to patient questions
links.effect: Mean Flesch-Kincaid grade level 12.1 ± 2.1 overall; responses required about a 12th-grade education to understand.
links.quote: The overall mean Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level was 12.1 ± 2.1.

links.outcome: Accuracy of responses when prompted for sixth-grade reading level versus unrestricted
links.effect: Accurate and complete responses 242 (85%) at sixth-grade prompt vs 220 (77%) standard; unacceptable 5 (2%) vs 16 (6%); no quality loss, significant improvement in cornea (P=0.001).
links.quote: Prompting the LLM to respond at a sixth-grade reading level did not result in a loss of response quality.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o answers to real patient questions graded by ophthalmologists
links.effect: 220 (77%) accurate and complete, 49 (17%) incomplete, 16 (6%) unacceptable; cornea only 53.9% accurate and complete.
links.quote: Overall, 220 (77%) responses were graded as accurate and complete, 49 (17%) as incomplete, and 16 (6%) as unacceptable.

links.outcome: Need for patient-specific context for AI answers to patient questions
links.effect: Context had to be added to 71 questions because they required prior patient knowledge; authors note answers may have been more complete with full EMR data.
links.quote: A brief explanation of context was added to 71 questions due to their requirement of prior knowledge of patients’ medical information (e.g., an existing diagnosis or the type of surgery performed recently).

links.outcome: Incomplete or unacceptable AI patient replies
links.effect: Standard ChatGPT-4o replies: 220/285 (77.2%) accurate and complete, 49 (17.2%) incomplete, 16 (5.6%) unacceptable.
links.quote: Overall, 220 (77%) responses were graded as accurate and complete, 49 (17%) as incomplete, and 16 (6%) as unacceptable.

links.effect: Accurate/complete increased from 220/285 (77.2%) to 242/285 (84.9%); unacceptable decreased from 16 (5.6%) to 5 (1.8%).
links.quote: When asked to respond at a sixth-grade reading level, 242 (85%) responses were graded as accurate and complete, 38 (13%) were incomplete, and 5 (2%) were graded as unacceptable.

links.quote: Overall, 220 (77%) responses were graded as accurate and complete, 49 (17%) as incomplete, and 16 (6%) as unacceptable.

links.effect: Overall mean Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level was 12.1 ± 2.1, requiring a high school education
